2105-4460-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1669-4247-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

305-3457-7791.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.

4243-4423-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Mystic Sanctuary using Venser, the Sojourner.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.
4243-4423-4872.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Time Warp if it's able to do so.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

4067-5672-7488.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-2366-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-2366-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-6255-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-6255-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1879-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1168-1479-2841-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1168-1479-2841-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5413-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

261-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
261-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Suture Priest, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Suture Priest and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

290-1987-2468-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Dreamstone Hedron and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3080-4499-4608.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn with {3} each extra turn
2724-3080-4499-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4499-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

915-2593-5856.notablePrerequisites:
Astral Cornucopia has at least three charge counters on it.
You control a Food.
915-2593-5856.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

2793-3743-4365-5089-5435.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4365-5089-5435.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1140-1636-3143-6166.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6166.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Oran-Rief Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Oran-Rief Hydra trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1621-4661.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Doppelganger.
1621-4661.description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Vesuvan Doppelganger enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Vesuvan Doppelganger. Choose to have Vesuvan Doppelganger enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

891-1585-2523-2921.easyPrerequisites: In Bolas's Clutches attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-1585-2523-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1558-1692-3263-3866.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Abhorrent Overlord.
1558-1692-3263-3866.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating at least one token copy of Abhorrent Overlord with haste.
When the Abhorrent Overlord token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Harpy creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Abhorrent Overlord token and the Harpy tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1946-2512-5306.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Nomads en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

593-1984-5109.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Mogg Maniac and you, with Angel's Grace causing your life total to become one instead.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

1883-2034-2634-4783.description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, targeting Replication Technique.
Choose to have Rootha returned to the command zone instead of your hand.
Resolve the Rootha ability, copying Replication Technique, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Resolve the copy of Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2561-3129-4798.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, creating two Food tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil twice, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Repeat.

920-1987-4863-5195.description:
Activate Kaza by tapping it, causing the next instant or sorcery spell you cast to cost at least {2} less.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Revolutionist and Kaza.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Kaza and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

751-1063-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
751-1063-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Shrieking Drake, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Oskar triggers, causing you to pay {U} to cast Shrieking Drake from your graveyard.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability from step 2, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

2835-4050-4963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
2835-4050-4963.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Fecundity.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, causing you to create a 2/2 Bear creature token the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat.

261-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
261-3957-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Suture Priest and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.

1606-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Weaver.
You control two lands that can produce a total of {1}{U} or more.
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
1606-3525.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2468-4872.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Time Warp without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2781-3603-4344.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

944-4050-4242-5105.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {W}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Sigil of New Dawn.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Sigil of New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {1}.
Repeat.
